lede: The biggest item this week is the Gondola Leadership Committee meeting on July 28, where the agenda flags a capital investment grant program and funding commitments as action items — not just a briefing, something is moving. Town Council also sits as the Liquor Licensing Authority on July 27 for a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive permit for July 30th at 207 N Pine. Rounding out the week, the Parks and Recreation Commission takes up a Humane Society request to use Elks Park and the River Trail for a fall dog-friendly 5K.
